note_tweet.text:
BREAKING 

The Norwegian Nobel Committee has awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay.

Pillay is a South African jurist of Indian Tamil descent.

She defended anti-apartheid activists, presided over the UN tribunal for Rwanda, served as a judge on the International Criminal Court, was UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, and chaired the UN inquiry into Israel and Gaza.

Pillay’s work on the Rwanda tribunal helped establish that rape can constitute an act of genocide.

Pillay headed the UN commission that concluded Israel committed genocide in Gaza. Her credibility was attacked by the Israeli government and various organizations that support the State of Israel.
